caption: The drawing depicts a single lion statue positioned sitting on its haunches with its left leg raised and its tail curled forward along the ground. The lion’s head is large with a full mane that covers much of its head, neck, and shoulders. The face features pronounced brows, a wide nose, and a closed mouth with a somber expression. The lion's body, mane, and face are illustrated using a mix of blue-gray and muted orange-brown hues, simulating the effect of weathered or corroded metal. The drawing has a high level of detail, with texture markings emphasizing the statue’s worn surface and flowing mane. The background is plain off-white with faint yellowish tape marks visible near the top left and bottom edges, framing the lion in the center. There are no other objects or scenery depicted in the image.
title: Lion
